title: Fractions, Decimals and Percentages
introduction: Build on earlier mathematics by studying fractions, decimals and percentages.
definition: A fraction is a quotient. Divide numerator by denominator to obtain its decimal form, and multiply the decimal value by 100 to express it as a percentage. Some fractions have repeating decimal expansions.
